signal: Praxent announced a strategic growth investment from Delta-v Capital in April 2026 to expand as an AI consulting and engineering firm built exclusively for fintech.

email.body1:
Kristiane, saw Praxent just took growth investment from Delta-v Capital to expand your fintech AI engineering practice.

Scaling an ABM motion that fast usually means more in-market financial-services accounts than the team can cover before momentum cools, and that is where deals slip. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a signal play for Praxent off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Kristiane, quick follow-up for Praxent.

After a growth investment, the pipeline target usually climbs faster than headcount can, and ABM coverage gets stretched thin. Most teams don't know exactly how many meetings they need to book to hit it, so the gap surfaces late and the quarter becomes a scramble.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I'll walk you through our pipeline model and show how many meetings Praxent needs to close that gap, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Kristiane, last bit of proof for Praxent.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Praxent's reply rate likely compares to other fintech services firms. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?
email.body4:
Kristiane, I'll stop reaching out on this one, but didn't want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling ABM pipeline without adding headcount isn't a priority this quarter, no problem at all. The stretch right after an investment is its own kind of busy, and I know timing matters.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to your ABM motion? I'll tailor it to Praxent either way.
